handoff: AC1–AC12 met and tested at S1/S2; full suite (1260) and typecheck green. No blocking findings. Minor: B13's 5 KB holds at harness scale, not on ~50-unit repos (decisions inline, D6); filtered why skips story facts of no-replay/corrupt ticks; chunk values not hash-checked on read. AC13 is the person's at ready.

findings.title: B13's 5 KB quiet tick does not hold at real scale
findings.detail:
Per the spike in handoff.md, a quiet tick on this repo's 51 units has ~18 KB inline, because the decisions stay inline (D6, ~250 B per noop decision). AC1 passes at harness scale. The spec's B13 example ('under 5 KB together') does not hold for repos with dozens of units.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: The person decides whether B13 should be reworded (for example, proportional to units) or whether noop decisions should be compacted in a later story.

findings.title: Filtered why ignores story facts of ticks with no replay block or a corrupt chunk
findings.detail:
unitIn now reads through reader.inputs. A full-facts tick recorded without a replay block (no_replay) used to give its stories from tick.facts directly; now uf is undefined, so `--step`/`--rule` filters may miss those ticks in `matches`. A corrupt tick is likewise dropped with no message.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: On no_replay, fall back to tick.facts.stories. Consider reporting corrupt ticks in the filtered listing.

findings.title: Chunk values are neither hash-checked nor validated
findings.detail:
DayChunks.get takes the first line whose prefix carries the hash and JSON.parses `v` without checking sha256(v) === h. A hand-edited chunk replays silently with different facts. Facts were never schema-validated before, so this is not a regression, but AGENTS.md asks that JSON reads be validated.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Verify the hash of the value text when parsing a chunk line, and treat a mismatch like a missing chunk (corrupt).

findings.title: Marker objects are unescaped; `__proto__` keys in rebuild
findings.detail:
rebuild resolves any single-key {$chunk}/{$blocks} object and drops `$chunked` at every depth. It builds `out` with plain assignment, so an own `__proto__` key would be lost. Current facts and config do not carry such keys.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Drop `$chunked` only at the top level. Build with Object.defineProperty or a null-prototype object if arbitrary payloads ever enter facts.

findings.title: Hash-prefix slicing duplicated
findings.detail:
`line.slice(HASH_PREFIX.length, HASH_PREFIX.length + 64)` appears in both scanHashes and DayChunks.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Use one helper, hashOf(line).

notes.text: B13 (AC1): a quiet tick is under 5 KB at harness scale, but ~18 KB on a 51-unit repo, because decisions stay inline (D6). Reword B13, or compact noop decisions later?
